source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנַ֗י ק֤וֹל גָּדוֹל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר קָרְב֖וּ פְּקֻדּ֣וֹת הָעִ֑יר וְאִ֛ישׁ כְּלִ֥י מַשְׁחֵת֖וֹ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he called in my ears [with] a loud voice, saying, Draw near, executioners of the city, and each his weapon of destruction in his hand.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "Draw near, you who are to punish the city, each [with] his weapon of destruction in his hand!"
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cried out in my hearing with a loud voice, "Come near, you who are appointed to punish the city, each with his weapon of destruction in his hand!"
en.R: Then I heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} shout in a loud voice, "Come here, you who will punish the city! Each of you, bring a weapon to destroy it!"

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} clamou aos meus ouvidos em alta voz, dizendo: "Aproximem-se, vocês que vão castigar a cidade, cada um com a sua arma de destruição na mão!"
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} gritou em alta voz aos meus ouvidos: "Venham, vocês que foram designados para castigar a cidade, cada um com a sua arma de destruição na mão!"
pt.R: Então eu {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ouvi gritar em alta voz: "Venham aqui, vocês que vão castigar a cidade! Cada um traga uma arma para destruí-la!"

sw.L: Naye akaita masikioni mwangu kwa sauti kuu, akisema, "Karibieni, ninyi mtakaouadhibu mji, kila mmoja [na] silaha yake ya uharibifu mkononi mwake!"
sw.B: Kisha akapaza sauti kuu masikioni mwangu, "Njooni karibu, ninyi mliowekwa kuuadhibu mji, kila mmoja na silaha yake ya uharibifu mkononi mwake!"
sw.R: Kisha nikamsikia akipaza sauti kuu, "Njooni hapa, ninyi mtakaouadhibu mji! Kila mmoja wenu alete silaha ya kuuangamiza!"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kêu lớn tiếng vào tai tôi rằng: "Hãy đến gần, hỡi những kẻ sẽ trừng phạt thành, mỗi người [cầm] vũ khí hủy diệt trong tay mình!"
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kêu lớn tiếng cho tôi nghe: "Hãy đến gần, hỡi những người được lập để trừng phạt thành, mỗi người cầm vũ khí hủy diệt trong tay!"
vi.R: Rồi tôi nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kêu lớn tiếng: "Hãy đến đây, hỡi những người sẽ trừng phạt thành! Mỗi người hãy mang theo vũ khí để hủy diệt thành!"

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 내 귀에 큰 소리로 외쳐 말씀하셨다. "성읍을 벌할 자들아, 저마다 멸망의 무기를 손에 들고 가까이 오너라!"
ko.B: 그때 그분께서 내가 듣는 데서 큰 소리로 외치셨다. "성읍을 벌하도록 정해진 자들아, 저마다 멸망의 무기를 손에 들고 가까이 오너라!"
ko.R: 그때 나는 그분께서 큰 소리로 외치시는 것을 들었다. "성을 벌할 자들아, 이리 오너라! 저마다 성을 멸망시킬 무기를 들고 오너라!"

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} cria à mes oreilles d’une voix forte, disant : « Approchez, vous qui devez punir la ville, chacun [avec] son arme de destruction à la main ! »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} cria d’une voix forte, et je l’entendis : « Approchez, vous qui êtes chargés de punir la ville, chacun avec son arme de destruction à la main ! »
fr.R: Alors je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ai entendu crier d’une voix forte : « Venez ici, vous qui allez punir la ville ! Que chacun de vous apporte une arme pour la détruire ! »

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} clamó a mis oídos con gran voz, diciendo: «¡{{plural_you:Acérquense|Acercaos}}, los que han de castigar la ciudad, cada uno con su arma de destrucción en la mano!».
es.B: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} gritó a gran voz para que yo lo oyera: «¡{{plural_you:Acérquense|Acercaos}}, los que han sido designados para castigar la ciudad, cada uno con su arma de destrucción en la mano!».
es.R: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oí gritar con fuerte voz: «¡{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} aquí, los que van a castigar la ciudad! ¡Que cada uno traiga un arma para destruirla!».

am.L: በታላቅ ድምፅም በጆሮዬ ጮኸ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «ከተማዪቱን የምትቀጡ ሆይ፣ እያንዳንዳችሁ የማጥፊያ መሣሪያችሁን በእጃችሁ [ይዛችሁ] ቅረቡ!»
am.B: ከዚያም እኔ እየሰማሁ በታላቅ ድምፅ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኸ፦ «ከተማዪቱን እንድትቀጡ የተሾማችሁ ሆይ፣ እያንዳንዳችሁ የማጥፊያ መሣሪያችሁን በእጃችሁ ይዛችሁ ቅረቡ!»
am.R: ከዚያም በታላቅ ድምፅ እንዲህ ብሎ ሲጮኽ ሰማሁት፦ «ከተማዪቱን የምትቀጡ ሆይ፣ ወደዚህ ኑ! እያንዳንዳችሁ ከተማዪቱን የምታጠፉበትን መሣሪያ ያዙ!»

hi.L: और उन्होंने ऊँचे स्वर से मेरे कानों में पुकारकर कहा, "हे नगर को दंड देनेवालो, निकट आओ, हर एक अपने हाथ में अपना विनाश का हथियार [लिए हुए]!"
hi.B: तब उन्होंने ऊँचे स्वर से मेरे सुनते हुए पुकारा, "हे नगर को दंड देने के लिए ठहराए हुए लोगो, निकट आओ, हर एक अपने हाथ में अपना विनाश का हथियार लिए हुए!"
hi.R: तब मैंने उन्हें ऊँचे स्वर से पुकारते सुना, "हे नगर को दंड देनेवालो, यहाँ आओ! तुम में से हर एक उसे नष्ट करने के लिए अपना हथियार ले आए!"

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} воззвал в мои уши громким голосом, говоря: «Приблизьтесь, наказывающие город, каждый со своим губительным оружием в руке!»
ru.B: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} громко воскликнул так, что я слышал: «Подойдите, вы, кому поручено наказать город, каждый со своим губительным оружием в руке!»
ru.R: Потом я услышал, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} громко крикнул: «Идите сюда, вы, кто накажет город! Пусть каждый возьмёт оружие, чтобы уничтожить его!»

ja.L: そしてその方は、大きな声でわたしの耳に呼ばわって言われた。「近づけ、都を罰する者たち、それぞれ滅ぼすための武器を手にして！」
ja.B: そのとき、その方はわたしの耳に聞こえるように大声で叫ばれた。「都を罰するために任じられた者たちよ、それぞれ滅ぼすための武器を手にして近づきなさい！」
ja.R: それから、その方が大きな声で叫ばれるのが聞こえました。「都を罰する者たちよ、ここに来なさい！それぞれ、都を滅ぼすための武器を持って来なさい！」

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} закликав у мої вуха гучним голосом, кажучи: «Наблизьтеся, ви, що маєте покарати місто, кожен [зі] своєю знищувальною зброєю в руці!»
uk.B: Тоді {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} гучно закликав, і я почув: «Підійдіть, ви, кому доручено покарати місто, кожен зі своєю зброєю знищення в руці!»
uk.R: Тоді я почув, як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} гучно закликав: «Ідіть сюди, ви, що покараєте місто! Кожен із вас, візьміть зброю, щоб знищити його!»

id.L: Dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berseru di telingaku dengan suara nyaring, katanya, "Mendekatlah, kalian yang akan menghukum kota ini, masing-masing [dengan] senjata pemusnahnya di tangannya!"
id.B: Lalu {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berseru di telingaku dengan suara nyaring, "Mendekatlah, hai kalian yang akan menghukum kota ini, masing-masing dengan senjata pemusnah di tangannya!"
id.R: Lalu aku mendengar {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berseru dengan suara nyaring, "Datanglah ke sini, kalian yang akan menghukum kota ini! Masing-masing bawalah senjata untuk membinasakannya!"

tl.L: At sumigaw {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}} sa aking mga tainga nang malakas na tinig, na nagsasabi, "Lumapit kayo, kayong magpaparusa sa lungsod, ang bawat isa na may hawak na sandatang pangwasak sa kaniyang kamay!"
tl.B: Pagkatapos ay sumigaw {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}} sa aking pandinig nang malakas na tinig, "Lumapit kayo, kayong itinalagang magparusa sa lungsod, ang bawat isa na may sandatang pangwasak sa kaniyang kamay!"
tl.R: Pagkatapos ay narinig ko {{deity_pronoun:siyang|Siyang}} sumigaw nang malakas, "Halikayo, kayong magpaparusa sa lungsod! Ang bawat isa sa inyo ay magdala ng sandata upang wasakin ito!"

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉੱਚੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਨੇੜੇ ਆਓ, ਹੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਜ਼ਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਿਓ, ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹਥਿਆਰ [ਲੈ ਕੇ]!"
pa.B: ਤਦ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਣਦਿਆਂ ਉੱਚੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਨਾਲ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ, "ਨੇੜੇ ਆਓ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਜ਼ਾ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ ਠਹਿਰਾਏ ਗਏ ਹੋ, ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਲੈ ਕੇ!"
pa.R: ਤਦ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਚੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਨਾਲ ਪੁਕਾਰਦੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ, "ਇੱਥੇ ਆਓ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਜ਼ਾ ਦੇਣੀ ਹੈ! ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਲੈ ਆਵੇ!"

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在我耳中大声呼叫，说：“要惩罚这城的人哪，你们要近前来，各人手中拿着他毁灭的兵器！”
zh.B: 然后{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在我耳边大声呼喊：“受命惩罚这城的人哪，你们要近前来，各人手中拿着毁灭的兵器！”
zh.R: 然后我听见{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}大声喊叫：“要惩罚这城的人哪，你们到这里来！每个人都要带一件毁灭这城的兵器！”

decisions.choice: draw near, you who are to punish the city: a summons to those appointed for judgment
alternatives: the punishments of the city have drawn near: a statement, not a command
decisions.reason: The verb can be a command ("draw near") or a statement ("they have drawn near"), and the noun can mean "those in charge of" or "the punishments of" the city. Since six armed men appear at once (9:2), the cry is read as a summons to them. The other reading also fits: the day of reckoning for the city has come (7:7, 12).

decisions.choice: he called in my ears with a loud voice: an answer to 8:18
decisions.reason: In 8:18 the LORD said that the people would cry "in my ears with a loud voice" and he would not listen. Now it is the LORD who cries out with a loud voice, calling the judgment.

decisions.choice: you who are appointed to punish the city (B); you who will punish the city (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the sense of people put in charge of the city's punishment (m1). Readable keeps it short.

decisions.choice: "Acérquense" / "Acercaos" (plural_you)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew summons the executioners in the plural; God's orders to them in 9:1–7 take the plural_you span

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: Ethiopic has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans in this chapter have nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; उन्होंने (honorific)
decisions.reason: The English marks pronouns for God with a deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans in this chapter; the honorific plural shows respect at every level.

decisions.choice: नगर को दंड देनेवाले
decisions.reason: Pequddot ha'ir, those appointed to punish the city (m1). The Hindi follows the English sense and does not say "executioners", which would name an earthly office.

decisions.choice: pequddot ha'ir: "都を罰する者たち" (L, R), "都を罰するために任じられた者たち" (B), as the English; Jerusalem as "都" in chapters 9-11.
decisions.reason: The phrase is uncertain (m1, footnoted): those appointed to punish. "都" is the usual word for Jerusalem as the capital and keeps the city from being 彼女.

decisions.choice: God's summons to the heavenly agents takes the forms of God's commands in the narrative: "近づけ" (L, the bare imperative of a summons), "近づきなさい" (B), "来なさい" (R); later prohibitions to them "〜してはならない" (L, B), "〜してはいけない" (R).
decisions.reason: The same forms as God's commands to Ezekiel (notes/EZK-EZK-1.md); Literal keeps the short cry of a summons.

decisions.choice: "kalian yang akan menghukum kota ini"
decisions.reason: A summons to those appointed for judgment (m1, uncertain; the noun can mean "punishments" or "overseers").

decisions.choice: "kayong magpaparusa sa lungsod"
decisions.reason: A summons to those appointed for judgment (m1).

decisions.choice: "sumigaw siya sa aking mga tainga nang malakas na tinig"
decisions.reason: An answer to 8:18 (m2).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans; honorific "ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ"
decisions.reason: The speaker is God, as in chapter 8.

decisions.choice: "ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਜ਼ਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਿਓ"
decisions.reason: Pequddot, those appointed to bring the city's punishment.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֣ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֡ים בָּאִ֣ים׀מִדֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֨עַר הָעֶלְי֜וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀מָפְנֶ֣ה צָפ֗וֹנָה וְאִ֨ישׁ כְּלִ֤י מַפָּצוֹ֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וְאִישׁ־אֶחָ֤ד בְּתוֹכָם֙ לָבֻ֣שׁ בַּדִּ֔ים וְקֶ֥סֶת הַסֹּפֵ֖ר בְּמָתְנָ֑יו וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַיַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל מִזְבַּ֥ח הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And behold, six men coming from [the] direction of [the] gate the upper which faces north, and each his weapon of smashing in his hand, and one man in their midst clothed [in] linen, and [the] writing case of the scribe at his waist; and they went in and stood beside [the] altar of the bronze.

en.L: And look, six men were coming by way of the upper gate that faces north, each with his weapon for smashing in his hand; and among them [was] one man clothed in linen, with a scribe's writing case at his waist. And they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
en.B: Then six men came from the direction of the upper gate that faces north, each with a weapon for smashing in his hand. Among them was a man dressed in linen, with a scribe's writing case at his side. They came in and took their places beside the bronze altar.
en.R: Then I saw six men coming from the upper gate, the one that faces north. Each of them held a weapon for smashing. With them was a man dressed in linen clothes. He carried a scribe's writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

pt.L: E eis que seis homens vinham pelo caminho da porta superior que dá para o norte, cada um com a sua arma de despedaçar na mão; e no meio deles [havia] um homem vestido de linho, com um estojo de escriba à cintura. E entraram e ficaram de pé junto ao altar de bronze.
pt.B: Então seis homens vieram da direção da porta superior, que dá para o norte, cada um com uma arma de despedaçar na mão. Entre eles havia um homem vestido de linho, com um estojo de escriba à cintura. Eles entraram e se puseram junto ao altar de bronze.
pt.R: Então vi seis homens que vinham da porta de cima, a que dá para o norte. Cada um segurava uma arma para despedaçar. Com eles estava um homem vestido com roupas de linho. Ele levava à cintura um estojo de escrever. Eles entraram e ficaram de pé ao lado do altar de bronze.

sw.L: Na tazama, watu sita walikuwa wakija kwa njia ya lango la juu linaloelekea kaskazini, kila mmoja na silaha yake ya kupondaponda mkononi mwake; na katikati yao [alikuwa] mtu mmoja aliyevaa kitani, na kidau cha wino cha mwandishi kiunoni mwake. Nao wakaingia wakasimama kando ya madhabahu ya shaba.
sw.B: Kisha watu sita wakaja kutoka upande wa lango la juu linaloelekea kaskazini, kila mmoja na silaha ya kupondaponda mkononi mwake. Kati yao alikuwepo mtu aliyevaa nguo za kitani, mwenye kidau cha wino cha mwandishi ubavuni mwake. Wakaingia wakasimama kando ya madhabahu ya shaba.
sw.R: Kisha nikaona watu sita wakija kutoka lango la juu, lile linaloelekea kaskazini. Kila mmoja wao alishika silaha ya kupondaponda. Pamoja nao alikuwepo mtu aliyevaa nguo za kitani. Alibeba vifaa vya mwandishi vya kuandikia ubavuni mwake. Wakaingia wakasimama kando ya madhabahu ya shaba.

vi.L: Và kìa, sáu người đang đến theo lối cổng trên, là cổng hướng về phía bắc, mỗi người [cầm] vũ khí để đập phá trong tay; và giữa họ [có] một người mặc vải gai, với hộp bút của người ký lục ở thắt lưng. Và họ đi vào và đứng bên cạnh bàn thờ bằng đồng.
vi.B: Bấy giờ có sáu người từ hướng cổng trên, là cổng hướng về phía bắc, đi đến, mỗi người cầm vũ khí để đập phá trong tay. Giữa họ có một người mặc áo vải gai, đeo hộp bút của người ký lục bên hông. Họ đi vào và đứng bên cạnh bàn thờ bằng đồng.
vi.R: Rồi tôi thấy sáu người từ cổng trên, là cổng hướng về phía bắc, đi đến. Mỗi người cầm một vũ khí để đập phá. Cùng đi với họ có một người mặc áo vải gai. Người ấy đeo bên hông một hộp đồ viết của người ký lục. Họ đi vào và đứng bên cạnh bàn thờ bằng đồng.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 여섯 사람이 북쪽을 향한 윗문 쪽에서 오고 있었는데, 저마다 부수는 무기를 손에 들고 있었다. 그들 가운데 베옷을 입은 사람 하나가 있었는데, 그의 허리에는 서기관의 필기구 통이 [있었다]. 그들이 들어와 놋 제단 곁에 섰다.
ko.B: 그때 여섯 사람이 북쪽을 향한 윗문 쪽에서 왔는데, 저마다 부수는 무기를 손에 들고 있었다. 그들 가운데 베옷을 입은 사람이 하나 있었는데, 허리에 서기관의 필기구 통을 차고 있었다. 그들이 들어와 놋 제단 곁에 섰다.
ko.R: 그때 여섯 사람이 북쪽을 향한 윗문에서 오는 것이 보였다. 그들은 저마다 무엇이든 부술 수 있는 무기를 들고 있었다. 그들과 함께 베옷을 입은 사람이 하나 있었다. 그는 허리에 서기관이 쓰는 필기도구를 차고 있었다. 그들은 들어와 놋 제단 곁에 섰다.

fr.L: Et voici, six hommes venaient par le chemin de la porte supérieure qui fait face au nord, chacun avec son arme pour fracasser à la main ; et au milieu d’eux [était] un homme vêtu de lin, avec une écritoire de scribe à la ceinture. Et ils entrèrent et se tinrent à côté de l’autel de bronze.
fr.B: Alors six hommes arrivèrent du côté de la porte supérieure qui fait face au nord, chacun avec une arme pour fracasser à la main. Parmi eux se trouvait un homme vêtu de lin, avec une écritoire de scribe à la ceinture. Ils entrèrent et se placèrent à côté de l’autel de bronze.
fr.R: Alors j’ai vu six hommes qui arrivaient par la porte supérieure, celle qui fait face au nord. Chacun tenait une arme pour fracasser. Avec eux, il y avait un homme habillé de lin. Il portait à la ceinture le matériel pour écrire d’un scribe. Ils sont entrés et se sont placés à côté de l’autel de bronze.

es.L: Y he aquí, seis hombres venían por el camino de la puerta superior que mira al norte, cada uno con su arma para destrozar en la mano; y entre ellos [había] un hombre vestido de lino, con un estuche de escriba en la cintura. Y entraron y se pusieron junto al altar de bronce.
es.B: Entonces seis hombres vinieron desde la puerta superior que mira al norte, cada uno con un arma para destrozar en la mano. Entre ellos había un hombre vestido de lino, con un estuche de escriba a la cintura. Entraron y se colocaron junto al altar de bronce.
es.R: Entonces vi a seis hombres que venían desde la puerta superior, la que mira al norte. Cada uno llevaba en la mano un arma para destrozar. Con ellos venía un hombre vestido con ropa de lino. Llevaba a la cintura un estuche de escriba. Entraron y se pusieron junto al altar de bronce.

am.L: እነሆም፣ ስድስት ሰዎች ወደ ሰሜን በሚመለከተው በላይኛው በር መንገድ ይመጡ ነበር፤ እያንዳንዱም የሚያደቅቅበትን መሣሪያ በእጁ [ይዞ ነበር]፤ በመካከላቸውም የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው [ነበረ]፤ በወገቡም የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ [ነበረ]። እነርሱም ገብተው በነሐሱ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ቆሙ።
am.B: ከዚያም ስድስት ሰዎች ወደ ሰሜን ከሚመለከተው ከላይኛው በር አቅጣጫ መጡ፤ እያንዳንዳቸው የሚያደቅቁበትን መሣሪያ በእጃቸው ይዘው ነበር። በመካከላቸውም በወገቡ የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ የያዘ፣ የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው ነበረ። እነርሱም ገብተው በነሐሱ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ቆሙ።
am.R: ከዚያም ስድስት ሰዎች ከላይኛው በር፣ ወደ ሰሜን ከሚመለከተው በር ሲመጡ አየሁ። እያንዳንዳቸው የሚያደቅቁበት መሣሪያ ይዘው ነበር። ከእነርሱም ጋር የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው ነበረ። በወገቡም የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ ይዞ ነበር። እነርሱም ገብተው በነሐሱ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ቆሙ።

hi.L: और देखो, छह पुरुष ऊपरी फाटक के मार्ग से आ रहे थे जिसका मुँह उत्तर की ओर है, हर एक के हाथ में अपना चूर-चूर करने का हथियार [था]; और उनके बीच सन का वस्त्र पहने हुए एक पुरुष [था], जिसकी कमर में लेखक की दवात [थी]। और वे भीतर जाकर पीतल की वेदी के पास खड़े हो गए।
hi.B: तब छह पुरुष उत्तर की ओर मुँह वाले ऊपरी फाटक की ओर से आए, और हर एक के हाथ में चूर-चूर करने का हथियार था। उनके बीच सन के वस्त्र पहने हुए एक पुरुष था, जिसकी कमर में लेखक की दवात थी। वे भीतर आकर पीतल की वेदी के पास खड़े हो गए।
hi.R: तब मैंने छह आदमियों को ऊपरी फाटक से आते देखा, उस फाटक से जिसका मुँह उत्तर की ओर है। हर एक के हाथ में चूर-चूर करने का हथियार था। उनके साथ सन के कपड़े पहने एक आदमी था। उसकी कमर में लिखने का सामान था। वे भीतर आकर पीतल की वेदी के पास खड़े हो गए।

ru.L: И вот, шесть человек шли со стороны верхних ворот, обращённых на север, и у каждого в руке своё оружие для разбивания; и среди них [был] один человек, одетый в льняную одежду, с чернильным прибором писца на поясе. И они вошли и встали у бронзового жертвенника.
ru.B: Тогда со стороны верхних ворот, обращённых на север, пришли шесть человек, у каждого в руке было оружие для разбивания. Среди них был человек, одетый в льняную одежду, с чернильным прибором писца на боку. Они вошли и встали у бронзового жертвенника.
ru.R: Потом я увидел шесть человек, которые шли от верхних ворот, тех, что обращены на север. Каждый держал в руке оружие для разбивания. С ними был человек в льняной одежде. У него на боку был набор писца для письма. Они вошли и встали у бронзового жертвенника.

ja.L: するとなんと、六人の男が、北に面している上の門の方から来た。それぞれ、打ち砕くための武器を手にしていた。そして彼らの中に一人の男がいて、亜麻布の衣を着、腰には書記の墨入れ[をつけていた]。彼らは入って来て、青銅の祭壇のそばに立った。
ja.B: すると、六人の男が北に面した上の門の方からやって来た。それぞれ、打ち砕くための武器を手にしていた。その中に、亜麻布の衣を着た一人の男がいて、腰に書記の墨入れをつけていた。彼らは入って来て、青銅の祭壇のそばに立った。
ja.R: すると、六人の男が、上の門、つまり北に面した門からやって来るのが見えました。それぞれ、打ち砕くための武器を持っていました。一緒に、亜麻布の服を着た男が一人いました。その男は、書記が使う筆記用具を腰につけていました。彼らは入って来て、青銅の祭壇のそばに立ちました。

uk.L: І ось шість чоловіків ішли дорогою від верхніх воріт, що обернені на північ, кожен зі своєю зброєю для розбивання в руці; а серед них [був] один чоловік, одягнений у льон, з письмовим приладдям писаря при боці. І вони ввійшли і стали біля мідного жертовника.
uk.B: Тоді шість чоловіків прийшли з боку верхніх воріт, що обернені на північ, кожен зі зброєю для розбивання в руці. Серед них був чоловік, одягнений у льон, з письмовим приладдям писаря при боці. Вони ввійшли і стали біля мідного жертовника.
uk.R: Тоді я побачив шістьох чоловіків, що йшли від верхніх воріт, тих, що обернені на північ. Кожен тримав зброю для розбивання. З ними був чоловік у лляному одязі. При боці він мав письмове приладдя писаря. Вони ввійшли і стали біля мідного жертовника.

id.L: Dan lihatlah, enam orang laki-laki datang dari arah pintu gerbang atas yang menghadap ke utara, masing-masing dengan senjata penghancurnya di tangannya; dan di antara mereka [ada] seorang laki-laki yang berpakaian kain lenan, dengan tempat tinta juru tulis pada pinggangnya. Dan mereka masuk dan berdiri di samping mezbah tembaga.
id.B: Tampaklah enam orang laki-laki datang dari arah pintu gerbang atas yang menghadap ke utara, masing-masing memegang senjata penghancur. Di antara mereka ada seorang laki-laki yang berpakaian kain lenan, dengan tempat tinta juru tulis pada pinggangnya. Mereka masuk dan berdiri di samping mezbah tembaga.
id.R: Lalu aku melihat enam orang laki-laki datang dari pintu gerbang atas, yang menghadap ke utara. Masing-masing memegang senjata untuk menghancurkan. Bersama mereka ada seorang laki-laki yang memakai pakaian dari kain lenan. Dia membawa alat tulis juru tulis di pinggangnya. Mereka masuk dan berdiri di samping mezbah tembaga.

tl.L: At narito, anim na lalaki ang dumarating mula sa daan ng itaas na pintuan na nakaharap sa hilaga, ang bawat isa ay may hawak na sandatang pandurog sa kaniyang kamay; at sa gitna nila ay may isang lalaking nakadamit ng lino, na may lalagyan ng panulat ng eskriba sa kaniyang baywang. At pumasok sila at tumayo sa tabi ng tansong altar.
tl.B: Pagkatapos ay dumating ang anim na lalaki mula sa direksiyon ng itaas na pintuan na nakaharap sa hilaga, ang bawat isa ay may sandatang pandurog sa kaniyang kamay. Kasama nila ang isang lalaking nakadamit ng lino, na may lalagyan ng panulat ng eskriba sa kaniyang tagiliran. Pumasok sila at tumayo sa tabi ng tansong altar.
tl.R: Pagkatapos ay nakita ko ang anim na lalaking dumarating mula sa itaas na pintuan, ang nakaharap sa hilaga. May hawak ang bawat isa sa kanila na sandatang pandurog. Kasama nila ang isang lalaking nakasuot ng damit na lino. May dala siyang lalagyan ng gamit sa pagsulat ng eskriba sa kaniyang tagiliran. Pumasok sila at tumayo sa tabi ng tansong altar.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਵੇਖੋ, ਛੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉੱਪਰਲੇ ਫਾਟਕ ਦੇ ਰਾਹੋਂ ਜੋ ਉੱਤਰ ਵੱਲ ਮੂੰਹ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਆ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ, ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਦੇ ਹੱਥ ਵਿੱਚ ਚਕਨਾਚੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹਥਿਆਰ; ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਇੱਕ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਮਲਮਲ ਪਹਿਨੇ ਹੋਏ [ਸੀ], ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਲੱਕ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਦਵਾਤ ਸੀ। ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਅੰਦਰ ਆ ਕੇ ਪਿੱਤਲ ਦੀ ਜਗਵੇਦੀ ਦੇ ਕੋਲ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋ ਗਏ।
pa.B: ਤਦ ਛੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉੱਤਰ ਵੱਲ ਮੂੰਹ ਕਰਦੇ ਉੱਪਰਲੇ ਫਾਟਕ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਆਏ, ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਦੇ ਹੱਥ ਵਿੱਚ ਚਕਨਾਚੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਸੀ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਮਲਮਲ ਦੇ ਕੱਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਨੀ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਸੇ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਦਵਾਤ ਸੀ। ਉਹ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਏ ਅਤੇ ਪਿੱਤਲ ਦੀ ਜਗਵੇਦੀ ਦੇ ਕੋਲ ਜਾ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋਏ।
pa.R: ਤਦ ਮੈਂ ਛੇ ਆਦਮੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਪਰਲੇ ਫਾਟਕ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਵੇਖਿਆ, ਉਸ ਫਾਟਕ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਮੂੰਹ ਉੱਤਰ ਵੱਲ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਨੇ ਚਕਨਾਚੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਫੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਸੀ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਇੱਕ ਆਦਮੀ ਮਲਮਲ ਦੇ ਕੱਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਨੀ ਸੀ। ਉਸ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਸੇ ਲਿਖਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਸੀ। ਉਹ ਅੰਦਰ ਆ ਕੇ ਪਿੱਤਲ ਦੀ ਜਗਵੇਦੀ ਕੋਲ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋ ਗਏ।

zh.L: 看哪，有六个人从朝北的上门那条路而来，各人手中拿着用来打碎的兵器；他们中间有一个人身穿细麻衣，腰间带着书记的墨盒。他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁边。
zh.B: 接着有六个人从朝北的上门那边过来，各人手中拿着打碎用的兵器。他们中间有一个人身穿细麻衣，腰间带着书记用的墨盒。他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁边。
zh.R: 然后我看见六个人从上门，就是朝北的那道门过来。他们每人手里拿着一件打碎东西用的兵器。和他们在一起的有一个人，穿着细麻布的衣服。他腰间带着书记用的笔墨盒。他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁边。

decisions.choice: six men and one man in linen: heavenly agents sent to carry out the judgment
decisions.reason: Like the destroyer of Exodus 12:23 and the angel of 2 Samuel 24:16, these are messengers of God's judgment, though the text calls them "men". The one dressed in linen is set apart from the six. Linen was the dress of priests (Leviticus 16:4) and of the heavenly messenger in Daniel 10:5 and 12:6-7.

decisions.choice: a scribe's writing case: the scribe's kit, worn at the belt
decisions.reason: A scribe carried a case or palette holding ink and reed pens, tucked into his belt at his side. The man in linen needs it to mark the faithful (9:4).

decisions.choice: the upper gate and the bronze altar of the temple
decisions.reason: King Jotham built "the upper gate of the house of the LORD" (2 Kings 15:35), probably this north gate. The bronze altar was Solomon's altar, which King Ahaz had moved to the north side to make room for an altar of his own (2 Kings 16:14). The men stand where the scenes of chapter 8 took place.

decisions.choice: a scribe's writing kit
alternatives: the writing case of the scribe
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plainer word for the case of pens and ink (m2).

decisions.choice: o homem vestido de linho; um estojo de escriba (L, B), um estojo de escrever (R)
alternatives: o homem de roupas de linho
decisions.reason: For the whole book (9:2-11; 10:2-7): the man (m1) is "o homem vestido de linho" at every level, one phrase each time he returns. His kit (m2) is "um estojo de escriba", a case for pen and ink, at Literal and Balanced, and "um estojo de escrever" at Readable, as the English Readable says "writing kit" (r-en-1); "tinteiro" names only the ink pot.

decisions.choice: mtu aliyevaa kitani; kidau cha wino cha mwandishi (L, B); vifaa vya mwandishi vya kuandikia (R)
decisions.reason: The man in linen keeps one wording through chapters 9 and 10. His scribe's case is "kidau cha wino", an ink-holder worn at the belt (meaning decision); Readable says simply writing things, as the English Readable says "writing kit".

decisions.choice: hộp bút của người ký lục (L, B); hộp đồ viết của người ký lục (R)
decisions.reason: The scribe's writing case worn at the belt. "Ký lục" names a scribe who writes; "thư ký" is kept for the royal secretary, as in the Ezra note. The heavenly men take no deity span and are "họ" in the narrative.

decisions.choice: "베옷을 입은 사람"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for the man clothed in linen, used in chapters 9-10 and in Daniel.

decisions.choice: "서기관의 필기구 통" (L, B); "서기관이 쓰는 필기도구" (R)
decisions.reason: A plain modern description of the scribe's kit (a case with pens and ink), rather than the older versions' wording.

decisions.choice: "un estuche de escriba"
decisions.reason: The scribe's case for pen and ink, said plainly at every level

decisions.choice: the man clothed in linen "የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው"; the writing case "የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ"
decisions.reason: The man in linen returns in verses 3 and 11 and in 10:2, 6, 7, and keeps these words each time. Linen is "የተልባ እግር ልብስ", the words of the Amharic Revelation 15:6 for the angels' linen; the writing case is described plainly rather than with the older "inkhorn". The bronze altar is "የነሐሱ መሠዊያ".

decisions.choice: सन का वस्त्र पहने हुए एक पुरुष (L); सन के वस्त्र पहने हुए (B); सन के कपड़े पहने एक आदमी (R)
decisions.reason: The man clothed in linen, a heavenly agent (m1), is described in the words of Daniel 10:5 in Hindi, level by level, since Daniel's figure is dressed the same way.

decisions.choice: लेखक की दवात (L, B); लिखने का सामान (R)
decisions.reason: The scribe's kit worn at the belt (m2), with its ink and pens; Readable says "writing things", as the English Readable says "kit".

decisions.choice: "чернильный прибор писца" (L, B); "набор писца для письма" (R)
decisions.reason: The scribe's case of pens and ink, worn at the belt (m2); Readable uses plainer words, as the English "writing kit".

decisions.choice: The man clothed in linen "亜麻布の衣を着た男" (L, B), "亜麻布の服を着た男" (R), as Daniel 10:5 (衣 / 服); qeset hassofer "書記の墨入れ" (L, B), "書記が使う筆記用具" (R).
decisions.reason: The writing case held pen and ink and hung from the belt (m2); "墨入れ" names it at L and B, Readable follows the English "writing kit". The man is a heavenly agent (m1) and takes plain verbs, as in Daniel.

decisions.choice: "seorang laki-laki yang berpakaian kain lenan"; "tempat tinta juru tulis" (L, B), "alat tulis juru tulis" (R); "mezbah tembaga"
decisions.reason: Heavenly agents in human form (m1); the scribe's kit worn at the belt (m2); the bronze altar (m3), "tembaga" as 1 Kings 7 has it.

decisions.choice: "anim na lalaki ... isang lalaking nakadamit ng lino"
decisions.reason: Heavenly agents sent to carry out the judgment (m1).

decisions.choice: "lalagyan ng panulat ng eskriba"
decisions.reason: The scribe's kit, worn at the belt (m2).

decisions.choice: "itaas na pintuan ... tansong altar"
decisions.reason: The upper gate and the bronze altar of the temple (m3).

decisions.choice: "ਮਲਮਲ ਪਹਿਨੇ ਹੋਏ" (L); "ਮਲਮਲ ਦੇ ਕੱਪੜੇ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Linen, the dress of priests and heavenly messengers.

decisions.choice: "ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਦਵਾਤ" (L, B); "ਲਿਖਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਨ" (R)
decisions.reason: Qeset hassofer, a scribe's writing case.

decisions.choice: "墨盒" (L, B); "笔墨盒" (R)
decisions.reason: The scribe's case of pens and ink, worn at the belt (m2); Readable names the pens as well.

source.text: וּכְב֣וֹד׀אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַעֲלָה֙ מֵעַ֤ל הַכְּרוּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עָלָ֔יו אֶ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַבָּ֑יִת וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶל־הָאִישׁ֙ הַלָּבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר קֶ֥סֶת הַסֹּפֵ֖ר בְּמָתְנָֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [the] glory of [the] God of Israel went up from upon the cherub which it had been upon it, to [the] threshold of the house; and he called to the man the clothed [in] the linen who [had] the writing case of the scribe at his waist.

en.L: Now the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the cherub on which it had been, to the threshold of the house. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called to the man clothed in linen, at whose waist [was] the scribe's writing case.
en.B: Now the glory of the God of Israel had risen from above the cherub where it had rested, and had moved to the threshold of the temple. He called to the man dressed in linen who had the writing case at his side.
en.R: The glory of the God of Israel rose up from above the cherub where it had been. It moved to the doorway of the temple. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called to the man dressed in linen who had the writing kit at his side.

pt.L: E a glória do Deus de Israel tinha subido de sobre o querubim sobre o qual estava, até a soleira da casa. E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} chamou o homem vestido de linho, que [tinha] à cintura o estojo de escriba.
pt.B: A glória do Deus de Israel tinha se elevado de cima do querubim onde estava e tinha ido até a soleira do templo. Ele chamou o homem vestido de linho que tinha o estojo de escriba à cintura.
pt.R: A glória do Deus de Israel se levantou de cima do querubim onde estava. Ela foi até a entrada do templo. Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} chamou o homem vestido de linho que tinha o estojo de escrever à cintura.

sw.L: Basi utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ulikuwa umepanda kutoka juu ya kerubi ambalo ulikuwa juu yake, mpaka kizingiti cha nyumba. Naye akamwita yule mtu aliyevaa kitani, ambaye kiunoni mwake [kilikuwa] kidau cha wino cha mwandishi.
sw.B: Basi utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ulikuwa umeinuka kutoka juu ya kerubi ulipokuwa umekaa, ukaenda mpaka kizingiti cha hekalu. Akamwita yule mtu aliyevaa nguo za kitani, mwenye kidau cha wino ubavuni mwake.
sw.R: Utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli uliinuka kutoka juu ya kerubi ulipokuwa. Ukaenda mpaka mlangoni mwa hekalu. Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwita yule mtu aliyevaa nguo za kitani, aliyekuwa na vifaa vya kuandikia ubavuni mwake.

vi.L: Bấy giờ vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên đã cất lên khỏi chê-ru-bim, là nơi vinh quang ấy đã ở trên, đến ngưỡng cửa của nhà. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi người mặc vải gai, là người có hộp bút của người ký lục ở thắt lưng.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên đã cất lên khỏi chê-ru-bim, nơi vinh quang ấy đã ngự, và dời đến ngưỡng cửa đền thờ. Ngài gọi người mặc áo vải gai đeo hộp bút bên hông.
vi.R: Vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên cất lên khỏi chê-ru-bim, nơi vinh quang ấy đã ở. Vinh quang ấy dời đến cửa đền thờ. Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gọi người mặc áo vải gai đeo hộp đồ viết bên hông.

ko.L: 그런데 이스라엘의 하나님의 영광이 머물러 있던 그룹 위에서 떠올라 그 집 문지방으로 [옮겨 갔다]. 그리고 그분께서 베옷을 입고 허리에 서기관의 필기구 통을 찬 그 사람을 부르셨다.
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘의 하나님의 영광이 머물러 있던 그룹 위에서 떠올라 성전 문지방으로 옮겨 갔다. 그분께서 베옷을 입고 허리에 필기구 통을 찬 그 사람을 부르셨다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님의 영광이 머물러 있던 그룹, 곧 날개 달린 하늘의 존재 위에서 떠올랐다. 그 영광은 성전 문간으로 옮겨 갔다. 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 베옷을 입고 허리에 필기도구를 찬 그 사람을 부르셨다.

fr.L: Or la gloire du Dieu d’Israël s’était élevée de dessus le chérubin sur lequel elle était, vers le seuil de la maison. Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} appela l’homme vêtu de lin, qui [avait] à la ceinture l’écritoire de scribe.
fr.B: Or la gloire du Dieu d’Israël s’était élevée au-dessus du chérubin où elle reposait, et s’était déplacée jusqu’au seuil du temple. Il appela l’homme vêtu de lin qui avait l’écritoire à la ceinture.
fr.R: La gloire du Dieu d’Israël s’est élevée au-dessus du chérubin où elle était. Elle est allée jusqu’à l’entrée du temple. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé l’homme habillé de lin qui avait le matériel pour écrire à la ceinture.

es.L: Y la gloria del Dios de Israel se había elevado de sobre el querubín sobre el cual estaba, hasta el umbral de la casa. Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llamó al hombre vestido de lino, que [tenía] en la cintura el estuche de escriba.
es.B: La gloria del Dios de Israel se había elevado de encima del querubín donde reposaba y se había trasladado al umbral del templo. Luego llamó al hombre vestido de lino que tenía el estuche de escriba a la cintura.
es.R: La gloria del Dios de Israel se elevó de encima del querubín donde había estado. Se trasladó a la entrada del templo. Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó al hombre vestido de lino que tenía el estuche de escriba a la cintura.

am.L: የእስራኤልም አምላክ ክብር ከነበረበት ከኪሩቡ ላይ ተነሥቶ ወደ ቤቱ መድረክ [ሄዶ ነበር]፤ እርሱም በወገቡ የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ ያለውን የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው ጠራው።
am.B: የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር አርፎበት ከነበረው ከኪሩቡ ላይ ተነሥቶ ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ መድረክ ሄዶ ነበር። እርሱም በወገቡ የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ የያዘውን የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው ጠራው።
am.R: የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር ከነበረበት ከኪሩቡ ላይ ተነሣ። ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ መግቢያ ሄደ። ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በወገቡ የጸሐፊ መጻፊያ ዕቃ የያዘውን የተልባ እግር ልብስ የለበሰው ሰው ጠራው።

hi.L: और इस्राएल के परमेश्वर की महिमा उस करूब पर से, जिस पर वह थी, भवन की दहलीज़ पर उठ गई थी। तब उन्होंने उस सन का वस्त्र पहने हुए पुरुष को पुकारा, जिसकी कमर में लेखक की दवात [थी]।
hi.B: इस्राएल के परमेश्वर की महिमा उस करूब के ऊपर से, जिस पर वह ठहरी थी, उठकर मन्दिर की दहलीज़ पर आ गई थी। उन्होंने सन के वस्त्र पहने हुए उस पुरुष को पुकारा जिसकी कमर में दवात थी।
hi.R: इस्राएल के परमेश्वर की महिमा उस करूब के ऊपर से उठी जहाँ वह थी। वह मन्दिर के द्वार की दहलीज़ पर आ गई। तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने सन के कपड़े पहने उस आदमी को पुकारा जिसकी कमर में लिखने का सामान था।

ru.L: А слава Бога Израиля поднялась с херувима, на котором была, к порогу дома. И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} позвал человека, одетого в льняную одежду, у которого на поясе [был] чернильный прибор писца.
ru.B: А слава Бога Израиля поднялась с херувима, над которым пребывала, и перешла к порогу храма. Он позвал человека, одетого в льняную одежду, у которого на боку был чернильный прибор.
ru.R: Слава Бога Израиля поднялась с херувима, над которым она была, и перешла ко входу в храм. Потом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} позвал человека в льняной одежде, у которого на боку был набор для письма.

ja.L: さて、イスラエルの神の栄光は、それがその上にあったケルブの上から上って、家の敷居に[移って]いた。そしてその方は、亜麻布の衣を着て、腰に書記の墨入れをつけている男を呼ばれた。
ja.B: さて、イスラエルの神の栄光は、それがとどまっていたケルブの上から上り、神殿の敷居に移っていた。その方は、亜麻布の衣を着て腰に墨入れをつけている男を呼ばれた。
ja.R: イスラエルの神の栄光は、それまでとどまっていたケルブの上から上りました。そして、神殿の入り口に移りました。そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、亜麻布の服を着て、腰に筆記用具をつけている男を呼ばれました。

uk.L: А слава Бога Ізраїлю піднялася з херувима, на якому була, до порога дому. І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} покликав чоловіка, одягненого в льон, у якого при боці [було] письмове приладдя писаря.
uk.B: Тим часом слава Бога Ізраїлю піднялася з-над херувима, де вона перебувала, і перейшла до порога храму. Він покликав чоловіка, одягненого в льон, що мав при боці письмове приладдя.
uk.R: Слава Бога Ізраїлю піднялася з-над херувима, де вона була. Вона перейшла до входу в храм. Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} покликав чоловіка в лляному одязі, що мав при боці письмове приладдя.

id.L: Kemuliaan Allah Israel telah naik dari atas kerub tempat kemuliaan itu tadinya berada, ke ambang pintu bait itu. Lalu {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} memanggil laki-laki yang berpakaian kain lenan, yang pada pinggangnya [ada] tempat tinta juru tulis.
id.B: Kemuliaan Allah Israel telah naik dari atas kerub tempat kemuliaan itu tadinya berada, dan pindah ke ambang pintu Bait Allah. Lalu {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} memanggil laki-laki yang berpakaian kain lenan, yang membawa tempat tinta juru tulis pada pinggangnya.
id.R: Kemuliaan Allah Israel naik dari atas kerub tempat kemuliaan itu tadinya berada, lalu pindah ke pintu masuk rumah Allah. Lalu {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} memanggil laki-laki berpakaian lenan yang membawa alat tulis di pinggangnya.

tl.L: At ang kaluwalhatian ng Diyos ng Israel ay pumaitaas mula sa kerubin na kinaroroonan nito, patungo sa pintuan ng bahay. At tinawag {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} ang lalaking nakadamit ng lino, na nasa baywang ang lalagyan ng panulat ng eskriba.
tl.B: Ang kaluwalhatian ng Diyos ng Israel ay pumaitaas mula sa ibabaw ng kerubin na pinamamalagian nito at lumipat sa pintuan ng templo. Tinawag niya ang lalaking nakadamit ng lino na may lalagyan ng panulat sa kaniyang tagiliran.
tl.R: Pumaitaas ang kaluwalhatian ng Diyos ng Israel mula sa ibabaw ng kerubin na kinaroroonan nito. Lumipat ito sa pintuan ng templo. Pagkatapos ay tinawag {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} ang lalaking nakadamit ng lino na may lalagyan ng gamit sa pagsulat sa kaniyang tagiliran.

pa.L: ਹੁਣ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦਾ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਉਸ ਕਰੂਬੀ ਉੱਤੋਂ ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਉਹ ਸੀ, ਭਵਨ ਦੀ ਦਹਿਲੀਜ਼ ਤੱਕ ਉੱਠ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ। ਤਦ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮਲਮਲ ਪਹਿਨੇ ਹੋਏ ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ, ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਲੱਕ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਦਵਾਤ [ਸੀ]।
pa.B: ਹੁਣ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦਾ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਉਸ ਕਰੂਬੀ ਦੇ ਉੱਤੋਂ ਉੱਠ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਹ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਹੈਕਲ ਦੀ ਦਹਿਲੀਜ਼ ਉੱਤੇ ਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮਲਮਲ ਦੇ ਕੱਪੜਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਸੱਦਿਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਸੇ ਦਵਾਤ ਸੀ।
pa.R: ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦਾ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਉਸ ਕਰੂਬੀ ਦੇ ਉੱਤੋਂ ਉੱਠਿਆ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਹ ਸੀ। ਉਹ ਹੈਕਲ ਦੇ ਦਰਵਾਜ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਦਹਿਲੀਜ਼ ਵੱਲ ਚਲਾ ਗਿਆ। ਤਦ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਮਲਮਲ ਦੇ ਕੱਪੜਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਉਸ ਆਦਮੀ ਨੂੰ ਸੱਦਿਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਸੇ ਲਿਖਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਸੀ।

zh.L: 以色列{{god_term:神|上帝}}的荣耀已经从它原来所在的基路伯上升起，到了殿的门槛。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}就呼叫那身穿细麻衣、腰间带着书记墨盒的人。
zh.B: 那时，以色列{{god_term:神|上帝}}的荣耀已经从它停留的基路伯上方升起，移到殿的门槛。他呼叫那身穿细麻衣、腰间带着墨盒的人。
zh.R: 以色列{{god_term:神|上帝}}的荣耀从它原来所在的基路伯上方升起，移到圣殿的门口。然后{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}呼叫那穿细麻布衣服、腰间带着笔墨盒的人。

decisions.choice: the cherub: the winged figures over the ark, above which the LORD was enthroned
decisions.reason: In the most holy place of Solomon's temple two great cherubim stood with outspread wings over the ark (1 Kings 6:23-28; 8:6-7), and the LORD was called the one "enthroned on the cherubim" (1 Samuel 4:4; Psalm 80:2). The singular here may mean the pair, or the cherubim of the glory itself; chapter 10 describes them (see 10:1).

decisions.choice: the glory moves to the threshold: the first step of its departure from the temple
decisions.reason: The glory leaves its place in stages: to the threshold (here and 10:4), to the east gate (10:18-19), and out of the city to the mountain on the east (11:22-23). In 43:1-5 it returns by the same east gate.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} called
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker, as the next verse does, so that "he" is not taken as the glory or the cherub.

decisions.choice: a glória do Deus de Israel subiu ... até a soleira; o querubim, os querubins
decisions.reason: For the departure of the glory (9:3; 10:4, 18-19; 11:22-23; its return 43:2-5): each stage (m2) keeps "a glória do Deus de Israel" or "a glória do SENHOR" as the Hebrew has it, with "subir"/"elevar-se" for its rising and "a soleira" for the threshold at Literal and Balanced, so the reader can follow its steps. The cherub (m1) is "o querubim", plural "os querubins", as the Old Testament terms set it.

decisions.choice: kerubi, makerubi
decisions.reason: The winged figure over the ark (meaning decision) is "kerubi", plural "makerubi", as in the published books, at every level; Readable explains the word once, at 10:1, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: chê-ru-bim (singular and plural)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 6:23 publishes it; the borrowed form serves for one cherub and for many, with "các" for the plural (chapter 10).

decisions.choice: "그룹" (L, B); "그룹, 곧 날개 달린 하늘의 존재" (R, once in this block)
decisions.reason: The published Korean word for the cherubim (1 Kings 6), which Readable explains once, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "le chérubin", "les chérubins" at every level, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word, the established French form.

decisions.choice: "el querubín"
decisions.reason: As published in Kings and Exodus (querubín, querubines)

decisions.choice: cherub "ኪሩብ" (plural "ኪሩቤል"); threshold "መድረክ"
decisions.reason: The cherub keeps the form of the Ezekiel terms list and of Exodus and Kings on main; chapter 10 names the creatures of chapter 1 cherubim. Readable names the LORD where the English does.

decisions.choice: करूब (cherub)
decisions.reason: The cherub is करूब, as in Exodus 25 and 1 Kings 6 (the plural करूबों in chapter 10). Here it is the cherub over the ark, above which the LORD was enthroned (m1).

decisions.choice: भवन की दहलीज़ (L); मन्दिर की दहलीज़ (B); मन्दिर के द्वार की दहलीज़ (R)
decisions.reason: Miftan, the threshold, is दहलीज़ through Ezekiel (as 40:6 and 46:2), kept apart from ड्योढ़ी, the porch; the glory's move there is the first step of its departure (m2), and the same word is used in 10:4 and 10:18.

decisions.choice: "херувим", "херувимы" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The form of Exodus 25:18-22, 1 Kings 6:23-28 and Psalms 80:2 and 99:1 in the Russian draft, used for the cherubim through Ezekiel 9-10.

decisions.choice: hakkeruv "ケルブ" (one cherub; plural "ケルビム"), as Exodus 25 and 2 Samuel 22; the house "家" (L), "神殿" (B, R); miftan "敷居" (L, B), "入り口" (R, the English doorway).
decisions.reason: The cherub here is the figure over the ark (m1); chapter 10 names the creatures of chapter 1 with the same word. Readable names the LORD as the English R does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "херувим", plural "херувими", at every level
decisions.reason: Following the Ezekiel terms table: the word is kept at every level, as in Exodus 25; chapter 10 names the living creatures of chapter 1 as херувими. Kept through the book.

decisions.choice: "kerub"; "bait itu" (L), "Bait Allah" (B), "rumah Allah" (R) for "the house"
decisions.reason: "kerub" is the glossary's word for the cherub (m1). "the house" here is the temple: Literal keeps "bait", Balanced and Readable name it as the glossary sets for the temple.

decisions.choice: "kerubin"
decisions.reason: The winged figures over the ark, above which the LORD was enthroned (m1).

decisions.choice: "pumaitaas ... patungo sa pintuan ng bahay"
decisions.reason: The first step of the glory's departure from the temple (m2).

decisions.choice: "ਕਰੂਬੀ" (cherub)
decisions.reason: The usual Punjabi Bible term.

decisions.choice: "ਭਵਨ ਦੀ ਦਹਿਲੀਜ਼" (L); "ਹੈਕਲ ਦੀ ਦਹਿਲੀਜ਼" (B); "ਹੈਕਲ ਦੇ ਦਰਵਾਜ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਦਹਿਲੀਜ਼" (R)
decisions.reason: The glory begins to leave the temple.

decisions.choice: "{{god_term:神|上帝}}" (god_term setting)
decisions.reason: Every word naming the one God is written with the god_term setting, "神" by default and "上帝" as the reader's alternative (style guide section 4).

decisions.choice: "基路伯"
decisions.reason: The glossary's form for the cherub, the winged figure above the ark.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו עֲבֹר֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר בְּת֖וֹךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְהִתְוִ֨יתָ תָּ֜ו עַל־מִצְח֣וֹת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַנֶּֽאֱנָחִים֙ וְהַנֶּ֣אֱנָקִ֔ים עַ֚ל כָּל־הַתּ֣וֹעֵב֔וֹת הַֽנַּעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to him, Go through [the] midst of the city, through [the] midst of Jerusalem, and mark a mark on [the] foreheads of the men who sigh and groan over all the abominations that are done in its midst.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Pass into the midst of the city, into the midst of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the {{gender:people|men}} who sigh and groan over all the abominations that are done in its midst."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Go all through the city, all through Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the {{gender:people|men}} who sigh and groan over all the detestable practices committed in it."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Go through the whole city of Jerusalem. Put a mark on the forehead of everyone who is sad and groaning over all the disgusting things being done there."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse: "Passa pelo meio da cidade, pelo meio de Jerusalém, e põe uma marca na testa {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}} que suspiram e gemem por causa de todas as abominações que se cometem no meio dela."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse: "Percorre toda a cidade, toda Jerusalém, e põe uma marca na testa {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}} que suspiram e gemem por todas as práticas detestáveis que se cometem nela."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a ele: "Percorre toda a cidade de Jerusalém. Põe uma marca na testa de todos os que estão tristes e gemem por causa de todas as coisas repugnantes que se fazem ali."

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Pita katikati ya mji, katikati ya Yerusalemu, ukatie alama juu ya vipaji vya nyuso vya watu wanaougua na kulia kwa ajili ya machukizo yote yanayotendwa katikati yake."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Pita katika mji wote, katika Yerusalemu yote, uweke alama juu ya vipaji vya nyuso vya watu wanaougua na kulia kwa ajili ya matendo yote ya kuchukiza yanayotendwa ndani yake."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Pita katika mji wote wa Yerusalemu. Weka alama kwenye kipaji cha uso cha kila mtu anayehuzunika na kuugua kwa sababu ya mambo yote ya kinyaa yanayofanyika humo."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với người ấy: "Hãy đi qua giữa thành, qua giữa Giê-ru-sa-lem, và đánh dấu trên trán những người thở than và rên rỉ vì mọi điều ghê tởm đã làm giữa thành."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với người ấy: "Hãy đi khắp thành, khắp Giê-ru-sa-lem, và đánh dấu trên trán những người thở than và rên rỉ vì mọi việc làm ghê tởm đã xảy ra trong thành."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với người ấy: "Hãy đi khắp thành Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy đánh dấu trên trán mọi người đang buồn rầu và than thở vì những việc ghê tởm người ta làm tại đó."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "성읍 가운데로, 예루살렘 가운데로 두루 다니며, 그 가운데서 저질러지는 모든 가증한 일 때문에 탄식하며 신음하는 사람들의 이마에 표를 하여라."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "성읍 안을, 예루살렘 안을 두루 다니며, 그 안에서 저질러지는 온갖 역겨운 짓 때문에 탄식하며 신음하는 사람들의 이마에 표를 하여라."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "예루살렘 성안을 두루 다니며 표시를 하여라. 성안에서 벌어지는 온갖 역겨운 일 때문에 슬퍼하며 신음하는 사람들의 이마마다 표시를 하여라."

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Passe au milieu de la ville, au milieu de Jérusalem, et fais une marque sur le front des {{gender:gens|hommes}} qui soupirent et gémissent à cause de toutes les abominations qui se commettent au milieu d’elle. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Parcours toute la ville, tout Jérusalem, et fais une marque sur le front des {{gender:gens|hommes}} qui soupirent et gémissent à cause de toutes les pratiques détestables qui s’y commettent. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a dit : « Parcours toute la ville de Jérusalem. Fais une marque sur le front de tous ceux qui sont tristes et qui gémissent à cause de toutes les choses dégoûtantes qu’on y fait. »

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Pasa por en medio de la ciudad, por en medio de Jerusalén, y pon una señal en la frente de {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} que gimen y se lamentan por todas las abominaciones que se cometen en medio de ella».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Recorre toda la ciudad, toda Jerusalén, y pon una señal en la frente de {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} que gimen y se lamentan por todas las prácticas detestables que se cometen en ella».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Recorre toda la ciudad de Jerusalén. Pon una señal en la frente de todos los que están tristes y gimen por todas las cosas repugnantes que se hacen allí».

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ አለው፦ «በከተማዪቱ መካከል፣ በኢየሩሳሌም መካከል እለፍ፤ በመካከሏም ስለሚደረጉት አስጸያፊ ነገሮች ሁሉ በሚያለቅሱና በሚቃትቱ ሰዎች ግንባር ላይ ምልክት አድርግ።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ አለው፦ «በከተማዪቱ ሁሉ፣ በኢየሩሳሌም ሁሉ ዙር፤ በእርሷ ውስጥ ስለሚፈጸሙት አስጸያፊ ነገሮች ሁሉ በሚያለቅሱና በሚቃትቱ ሰዎች ግንባር ላይ ምልክት አድርግ።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ አለው፦ «በኢየሩሳሌም ከተማ ሁሉ ዙር። በዚያ ስለሚደረጉት አስጸያፊ ነገሮች ሁሉ በሚያዝኑና በሚቃትቱ ሰዎች ሁሉ ግንባር ላይ ምልክት አድርግ።»

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उससे कहा, "नगर के बीच में से, यरूशलेम के बीच में से होकर जाओ, और उन {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}} के माथों पर निशान लगाओ जो उसके बीच किए जानेवाले सब घृणित कामों के कारण आहें भरते और कराहते हैं।"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उससे कहा, "सारे नगर में, सारे यरूशलेम में घूमो, और उन {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}} के माथों पर निशान लगाओ जो उसमें किए जानेवाले सब घृणित कामों के कारण आहें भरते और कराहते हैं।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उससे कहा, "सारे यरूशलेम नगर में घूमो। हर उस व्यक्ति के माथे पर निशान लगाओ जो वहाँ हो रहे सब घिनौने कामों के कारण दुखी है और कराह रहा है।"

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ему: «Пройди посреди города, посреди Иерусалима, и поставь знак на лбах {{gender:людей|мужей}}, вздыхающих и стонущих о всех мерзостях, совершаемых посреди него.»
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал ему: «Пройди по всему городу, по всему Иерусалиму, и поставь знак на лбах {{gender:людей|мужей}}, которые вздыхают и стонут о всех мерзких делах, совершаемых в нём.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал ему: «Пройди по всему городу Иерусалиму. Поставь знак на лбу у каждого, кто горюет и стонет из-за всех отвратительных дел, которые там совершаются.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼に言われた。「都のただ中を、エルサレムのただ中を通り、そのただ中で行われているすべての忌み嫌うべきことのために嘆き、うめいている{{gender:人々|男たち}}の額に、しるしをつけなさい。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼に言われた。「都の中を、エルサレムの中をくまなく巡り、そこで行われているすべての忌まわしい行いのために嘆き、うめいている{{gender:人々|男たち}}の額に、しるしをつけなさい。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はその男に言われました。「エルサレムの都の中を、すみずみまで回りなさい。そこで行われている汚らわしいことのために悲しみ、うめいている人がいたら、一人一人の額にしるしをつけなさい。」

uk.L: І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав йому: «Пройди посеред міста, посеред Єрусалима, і постав знак на чолах {{gender:людей|чоловіків}}, що зітхають і стогнуть через усі гидоти, що чиняться посеред нього.»
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав йому: «Пройди через усе місто, через увесь Єрусалим, і постав знак на чолах {{gender:людей|чоловіків}}, що зітхають і стогнуть через усі огидні звичаї, що в ньому чиняться.»

decisions.choice: a mark: the Hebrew is the name of the letter taw, which was written as a simple cross
decisions.reason: The word is the name of the last letter of the Hebrew alphabet. In the old Hebrew script it had the shape of an X or a cross, so the mark was a simple sign, like a signature (Job 31:35 uses the word for a signature). Later readers, Jewish and Christian, drew meanings from its shape, but the text says only that it marks those to be spared.

decisions.choice: the mark on the foreheads: those who belong to God are spared, as in Exodus 12:13 and Revelation 7:3; 9:4
decisions.reason: As the blood on the doorposts spared Israel's houses in Egypt (Exodus 12:13), the mark spares these people. Revelation 7:3 and 9:4 take up the picture: the servants of God are sealed on their foreheads before the judgment falls.

decisions.choice: those who sigh and groan: the people who grieve over the city's sins, not only those who avoid them
decisions.reason: Judgment does not fall on everyone alike. The LORD distinguishes those who mourn over what is done in Jerusalem from those who do it, as Abraham asked that the righteous not be swept away with the wicked (Genesis 18:23-25). Chapter 18 makes the same point in teaching.

decisions.choice: the {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "men" here means people: the sparing is not limited to men, as the list of those to be struck in 9:6 shows. Readable says "everyone", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: uma marca na testa (every level)
decisions.reason: The mark (m1, m2) is "uma marca", the plain word for a written sign of ownership, kept apart from "sinal", which the book uses for the prophet's acted signs (4:3). Revelation 7:3 and 9:4 take up the picture with a seal; the meaning note gives the link.

decisions.choice: alama
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the letter taw, written as a simple cross (meaning decision). Swahili says "alama", a mark, at every level, as the English does, and leaves the letter to the footnote; "muhuri" would bring in Revelation's seal.

decisions.choice: những người, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "people / men" as a setting. "Những người" includes men and women, so Vietnamese has no second wording.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람들" covers women and men, so the English gender span has no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: "las personas" / "los hombres" (gender setting)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "men" stands for everyone who grieves, and Spanish has two wordings here, so the span follows the English

decisions.choice: "una señal"
decisions.reason: Plain "señal", as Revelation 7:3 and 9:4 in Spanish speak of the seal on the forehead

decisions.choice: "በ ... ግንባር ላይ ምልክት አድርግ" at every level
decisions.reason: Revelation 7:3 and 9:4 echo this verse: God's servants are sealed on their foreheads. The Amharic Revelation has "በግንባራቸው ላይ" ("on their foreheads"), which is kept; but the Hebrew taw is a mark, not a seal, so it is "ምልክት", the word Revelation 9:4 Readable uses ("የእግዚአብሔር ምልክት"), not "ማኅተም". Verse 6 keeps "ምልክቱ".

decisions.choice: "ሰዎች" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "ሰዎች" already means people, men and women, so the English setting "people / men" has nothing to switch in Amharic.

decisions.choice: निशान लगाना (taw)
decisions.reason: The mark is the letter taw, then written as a simple cross (m1). निशान is the plain word for a mark made on someone, kept apart from चिह्न, the word for a sign (ot) in 4:3. The marked are spared, as in Exodus 12:13 and Revelation 7:3 (m2).

decisions.choice: {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}} (L, B); हर उस व्यक्ति (R)
decisions.reason: As the English does, Literal and Balanced offer "people" by default and "men" as the alternative for anashim; Readable says "everyone", which needs no span.

decisions.choice: {{gender:людей|мужей}} (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in English and as the style guide gives it for a word for "men" that means people: the sparing is not only for men (9:6). Readable says "у каждого", as the English says "everyone".

decisions.choice: vehitvita tav: "しるしをつけなさい" at every level; the gender span "{{gender:人々|男たち}}" at L and B as the English, none at R ("人" is already inclusive, as the English R "everyone").
decisions.reason: The mark is the letter taw, once written as a cross (m1, footnoted in the English); Japanese says "しるし", as at Exodus 12:13 and Revelation 7:3 (印 / しるし), and leaves the letter to the footnote.

decisions.choice: "tanda" for the mark
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the name of the letter taw, written as a simple cross (m1); those who belong to God are spared (m2). Indonesian "tanda" says what it is at every level, as the English "mark" does.

decisions.choice: "tanda"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the name of the letter taw, written as a simple cross (m1).

decisions.choice: "lagyan mo ng tanda ang mga noo"
decisions.reason: Those who belong to God are spared, as in Exodus 12:13 and Revelation 7:3; 9:4 (m2).

decisions.choice: "nagbubuntong-hininga at dumaraing"
decisions.reason: Those who grieve over the city's sins (m3).

decisions.choice: "ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਲਾਉਣਾ" (taw)
decisions.reason: Taw, the last letter, written then like a cross or X.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:ਲੋਕਾਂ|ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ}}" (L, B); "ਹਰ ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ" (R)
decisions.reason: Anashim, here everyone who grieves, women included.

decisions.choice: "额上" (L, B); "额头上" (R); "记号"
decisions.reason: The mark on the foreheads of those who are spared is echoed in Revelation 7:3 and 9:4, whose Chinese says "额上" / "额头上" as here. The Hebrew word is the letter taw (m1), a simple mark, so "记号" rather than Revelation's "印" (a seal), which is a different word.

decisions.choice: "人", no gender span
decisions.reason: The English gives "people / men" through the gender setting; Chinese "人" already includes men and women, so no span is needed (style guide section 8).

records.literal_gloss: And to these he said in my ears, Pass through the city after him and strike; [let] not spare your eye, and do not have pity.

en.L: And to the others {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said in my hearing, "Pass through the city after him and strike! Let your eye not pity, and do not spare.
en.B: To the others {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said in my hearing, "Follow him through the city and strike. Do not look on them with pity or spare them.
en.R: Then I heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} say to the others, "Follow him through the city and kill. Do not feel sorry for them or show them mercy.

pt.L: E aos outros {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse aos meus ouvidos: "Passem pela cidade atrás dele e firam! Que o olho de vocês não tenha piedade, e não poupem.

fr.R: Puis je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ai entendu dire aux autres : « Suivez-le à travers la ville et tuez. N’ayez pas pitié d’eux et ne leur faites pas grâce.

es.R: Luego {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oí decir a los otros: «{{plural_you:Síganlo|Seguidlo}} por la ciudad y {{plural_you:maten|matad}}. No {{plural_you:sientan|sintáis}} lástima por ellos ni les {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} compasión.

ru.L: А другим {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал так, что я слышал: «Пройдите по городу за ним и поражайте! Пусть не сжалится ваше око, и не щадите.
ru.B: Другим {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал так, что я слышал: «Идите за ним по городу и поражайте. Не смотрите на них с жалостью и не щадите их.

ja.R: それから、その方がほかの者たちに言われるのが聞こえました。「あの男の後について都を回り、殺しなさい。かわいそうに思ってはいけない。あわれみを示してはいけない。

uk.L: А іншим {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав у мої вуха: «Пройдіть через місто за ним і бийте! Хай ваше око не змилосердиться, і не щадіть.

id.L: Dan kepada yang lain {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berfirman di telingaku, "Lintasilah kota itu di belakangnya dan pukullah! Janganlah matamu merasa sayang, dan janganlah berbelas kasihan.
id.B: Kepada yang lain {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berfirman sementara aku mendengarnya, "Ikutilah dia melintasi kota itu dan bunuhlah! Jangan merasa sayang dan jangan berbelas kasihan.
id.R: Lalu aku mendengar {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berfirman kepada yang lain, "Ikutilah dia berkeliling kota dan bunuhlah. Jangan merasa kasihan kepada mereka dan jangan menunjukkan belas kasihan.

tl.L: At sa iba ay sinabi {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} sa aking pandinig, "Dumaan kayo sa lungsod na kasunod niya at pumatay kayo! Huwag mahabag ang inyong mata, at huwag kayong magpatawad.
tl.B: Sa iba naman ay sinabi {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} sa aking pandinig, "Sumunod kayo sa kaniya sa buong lungsod at pumatay. Huwag ninyo silang titingnan nang may habag o patatawarin.
tl.R: Pagkatapos ay narinig ko {{deity_pronoun:siyang|Siyang}} nagsabi sa iba, "Sumunod kayo sa kaniya sa buong lungsod at pumatay. Huwag kayong maaawa sa kanila o magpapakita ng habag.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਣਦਿਆਂ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ-ਪਿੱਛੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਲੰਘੋ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਰੋ! ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਅੱਖ ਤਰਸ ਨਾ ਕਰੇ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਾ ਛੱਡੋ।
pa.B: ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਣਦਿਆਂ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਗਰ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਰੋ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਾ ਤਰਸ ਖਾਓ, ਨਾ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡੋ।
pa.R: ਫਿਰ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਆਖਦੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ, "ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਗਰ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਰ ਸੁੱਟੋ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਾ ਤਰਸ ਖਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਨਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੋ।

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在我耳中对其余的人说：“你们要跟随他走遍全城，去击杀！你们的眼不要顾惜，也不要怜悯。
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在我耳边对其余的人说：“你们要跟着他走遍全城，去击杀。你们不要怜惜他们，也不要宽恕他们。
zh.R: 然后我听见{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}对其余的人说：“你们要跟着他走遍全城，去杀人。你们不要可怜他们，也不要对他们仁慈。

decisions.choice: let your eye not pity, and do not spare: the words of 8:18 and 5:11, now given to the executioners
decisions.reason: The LORD said in 8:18 that his eye would not spare. The same words are now his command to the six men.

decisions.choice: kill
decisions.reason: "Strike" here means strike dead, as 9:6-7 make plain; Readable says "kill".

decisions.choice: các ngươi for the executioners
decisions.reason: God gives orders to the six men with "các ngươi", as to servants carrying out his word.

decisions.choice: तुम्हारी आँख तरस न खाए, और तुम न छोड़ो (L); न तरस खाओ और न छोड़ो (B); न तरस खाओ और न दया करो (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of 5:11 and 8:18, now given to the executioners (m1), in the same words at each level.

decisions.choice: "пусть не сжалится ваше око, и не щадите" (L); "не смотрите с жалостью и не щадите" (B); "не жалейте и не милуйте" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 5:11 and 8:18, now given to the executioners (m1).

decisions.choice: "Let your eye not pity, and do not spare" given to the executioners: "あなたがたの目はあわれんではならない。惜しんではならない" (L), "あわれみの目で見てはならない。容赦してはならない" (B), "かわいそうに思ってはいけない。あわれみを示してはいけない" (R).
decisions.reason: The words God spoke of himself in 8:18 and 5:11 (m1), in the same Japanese turned into prohibitions, so the echo is heard at each level.

decisions.choice: "Huwag mahabag ang inyong mata, at huwag kayong magpatawad"
decisions.reason: The words of 8:18 and 5:11, now given to the executioners (m1).

decisions.choice: "ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਅੱਖ ਤਰਸ ਨਾ ਕਰੇ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਾ ਛੱਡੋ" (L); "ਨਾ ਤਰਸ ਖਾਓ, ਨਾ ... ਛੱਡੋ" (B); "ਨਾ ਤਰਸ ਖਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਨਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੋ" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:4, addressed to the six.

decisions.choice: "你们的眼不要顾惜，也不要怜悯" (L); "不要怜惜……也不要宽恕" (B); "不要可怜……也不要对他们仁慈" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 5:11 and 8:18, now as a command.

source.text: זָקֵ֡ן בָּח֣וּר וּבְתוּלָה֩ וְטַ֨ף וְנָשִׁ֜ים תַּהַרְג֣וּ לְמַשְׁחִ֗ית וְעַל־כָּל־אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָ֤יו הַתָּו֙ אַל־תִּגַּ֔שׁוּ וּמִמִּקְדָּשִׁ֖י תָּחֵ֑לּוּ וַיָּחֵ֨לּוּ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: Old man, young man and young woman, and little children and women, kill to destruction; but upon any man who [has] upon him the mark, do not come near; and from my sanctuary begin. And they began with the men, the elders, who [were] before the house.

en.L: Old man, young man and young woman, little children and women, kill to destruction; but do not come near anyone on whom [is] the mark. And begin from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary." So they began with the men, the elders, who [were] in front of the house.
en.B: Kill old men, young men and young women, little children and women, until none are left; but do not go near anyone who has the mark. Start at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary." So they began with the elders standing in front of the temple.
en.R: Kill them all: old men, young men and young women, women and little children. But do not touch anyone who has the mark. Start at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple." So they started with the elders who were in front of the temple.

pt.L: Velho, jovem e moça, crianças e mulheres, matem até a destruição; mas não se aproximem de ninguém sobre quem [estiver] a marca. E comecem pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} santuário." E começaram pelos homens, os anciãos, que [estavam] diante da casa.
pt.B: Matem velhos, jovens e moças, crianças e mulheres, até não sobrar ninguém; mas não cheguem perto de ninguém que tenha a marca. Comecem pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} santuário." Então começaram pelos anciãos que estavam diante do templo.
pt.R: Matem todos: velhos, jovens e moças, mulheres e crianças. Mas não toquem em ninguém que tenha a marca. Comecem pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} templo." Então começaram pelos anciãos que estavam na frente do templo.

sw.L: Mzee, kijana na msichana, watoto wadogo na wanawake, ueni hata kuangamiza; lakini msimkaribie mtu yeyote ambaye juu yake [iko] alama. Nanyi anzeni kutoka patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}." Basi wakaanza na wale watu, wazee, waliokuwa mbele ya nyumba.
sw.B: Waueni wazee, vijana wa kiume na wasichana, watoto wadogo na wanawake, hata asibaki mtu; lakini msimkaribie yeyote mwenye alama. Anzeni katika patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}." Basi wakaanza na wale wazee waliosimama mbele ya hekalu.
sw.R: Waueni wote: wazee, vijana wa kiume na wasichana, wanawake na watoto wadogo. Lakini msimguse mtu yeyote mwenye alama. Anzeni katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}." Basi wakaanza na wale wazee waliokuwa mbele ya hekalu.

vi.L: Ông già, thanh niên và thiếu nữ, trẻ nhỏ và phụ nữ, hãy giết cho đến tận diệt; nhưng đừng đến gần bất cứ ai có dấu trên mình. Và hãy bắt đầu từ đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." Vậy họ bắt đầu với những người, là các trưởng lão, [đang ở] trước nhà.
vi.B: Hãy giết cả ông già, thanh niên và thiếu nữ, trẻ nhỏ và phụ nữ, cho đến khi không còn ai; nhưng đừng đến gần người nào có dấu. Hãy bắt đầu từ đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." Vậy họ bắt đầu với các trưởng lão đang đứng trước đền thờ.
vi.R: Hãy giết hết: ông già, thanh niên và thiếu nữ, phụ nữ và trẻ nhỏ. Nhưng đừng đụng đến ai có dấu. Hãy bắt đầu từ nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." Vậy họ bắt đầu với các trưởng lão đang ở trước đền thờ.

ko.L: 늙은이와 젊은 남자와 처녀와 어린아이와 여자를 죽여 없애라. 그러나 표가 있는 사람에게는 아무에게도 가까이 가지 마라. 그리고 내 성소에서부터 시작하여라." 그래서 그들은 그 집 앞에 있던 사람들, 곧 장로들에게서부터 시작했다.
ko.B: 노인과 젊은 남자와 젊은 여자와 어린아이와 여자를 하나도 남김없이 죽여라. 그러나 표가 있는 사람에게는 가까이 가지 마라. 내 성소에서부터 시작하여라." 그래서 그들은 성전 앞에 있던 장로들에게서부터 시작했다.
ko.R: 노인이든 젊은 남자든 젊은 여자든, 여자든 어린아이든 모두 죽여라. 그러나 표시가 있는 사람은 건드리지 마라. 내 성전에서부터 시작하여라." 그래서 그들은 성전 앞에 있던 장로들부터 죽이기 시작했다.

fr.L: Vieillard, jeune homme et jeune fille, petits enfants et femmes, tuez jusqu’à la destruction ; mais n’approchez d’aucun de ceux sur qui [est] la marque. Et commencez par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire. » Et ils commencèrent par les hommes, les anciens, qui [étaient] devant la maison.
fr.B: Tuez vieillards, jeunes gens et jeunes filles, petits enfants et femmes, jusqu’à ce qu’il n’en reste aucun ; mais n’approchez d’aucun de ceux qui portent la marque. Commencez par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire. » Ils commencèrent donc par les anciens qui se tenaient devant le temple.
fr.R: Tuez-les tous : les vieillards, les jeunes gens et les jeunes filles, les femmes et les petits enfants. Mais ne touchez à personne qui porte la marque. Commencez par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple. » Alors ils ont commencé par les anciens qui étaient devant le temple.

es.L: A anciano, a joven y a doncella, a niños y a mujeres, {{plural_you:maten|matad}} hasta exterminar; pero no {{plural_you:se acerquen|os acerquéis}} a nadie sobre quien [esté] la señal. Y {{plural_you:comiencen|comenzad}} por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario». Y comenzaron por los hombres, los ancianos, que [estaban] delante de la casa.
es.B: {{plural_you:Maten|Matad}} a ancianos, jóvenes y doncellas, a niños y mujeres, hasta que no quede nadie; pero no {{plural_you:se acerquen|os acerquéis}} a nadie que tenga la señal. {{plural_you:Comiencen|Comenzad}} por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario». Así que comenzaron por los ancianos que estaban delante del templo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Mátenlos|Matadlos}} a todos: ancianos, jóvenes, muchachas, mujeres y niños. Pero no {{plural_you:toquen|toquéis}} a nadie que tenga la señal. {{plural_you:Comiencen|Comenzad}} por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo». Así que comenzaron por los ancianos que estaban delante del templo.

am.L: ሽማግሌውንና ጎበዙን፣ ቆንጆይቱንም፣ ሕፃናቱንና ሴቶቹን ፈጽማችሁ ግደሉ፤ ምልክቱ ያለበትን ሰው ሁሉ ግን አትቅረቡ። ከመቅደሴም ጀምሩ።» እነርሱም በቤቱ ፊት ከነበሩት ሰዎች፣ ከሽማግሌዎቹ ጀመሩ።
am.B: ሽማግሌዎችን፣ ጎበዛዝትንና ቆነጃጅትን፣ ሕፃናትንና ሴቶችን አንድ ሳታስቀሩ ግደሉ፤ ምልክቱ ያለበትን ሰው ሁሉ ግን አትቅረቡ። ከመቅደሴ ጀምሩ።» ስለዚህ በቤተ መቅደሱ ፊት ቆመው ከነበሩት ሽማግሌዎች ጀመሩ።
am.R: ሁሉንም ግደሉ፤ ሽማግሌዎችን፣ ወጣት ወንዶችንና ወጣት ሴቶችን፣ ሴቶችንና ሕፃናትን ግደሉ። ምልክቱ ያለበትን ሰው ሁሉ ግን አትንኩ። ከቤተ መቅደሴ ጀምሩ።» ስለዚህ በቤተ መቅደሱ ፊት ከነበሩት ሽማግሌዎች ጀመሩ።

hi.L: बूढ़े, जवान और कुँवारी, बच्चे और स्त्रियाँ, सब को मारकर नाश कर डालो; पर जिस किसी पर निशान [हो], उसके पास न जाना। और मेरे पवित्रस्थान से आरंभ करो।" तब उन्होंने उन पुरुषों से, उन पुरनियों से जो भवन के सामने [थे], आरंभ किया।
hi.B: बूढ़ों, जवानों और युवतियों, बच्चों और स्त्रियों को मार डालो, यहाँ तक कि कोई न बचे; पर जिस किसी पर निशान हो, उसके पास न जाना। मेरे पवित्रस्थान से आरंभ करो।" तब उन्होंने उन बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों से आरंभ किया जो मन्दिर के सामने खड़े थे।
hi.R: सब को मार डालो: बूढ़ों, जवानों और युवतियों, स्त्रियों और छोटे बच्चों को। पर जिस किसी पर निशान हो, उसे मत छूना। मेरे मन्दिर से शुरू करो।" तब उन्होंने उन बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों से शुरू किया जो मन्दिर के सामने थे।

ru.L: Старика, юношу и девушку, и малых детей, и женщин убивайте до истребления; но не приближайтесь ни к кому, на ком знак. И начните с {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} святилища.» И они начали с людей, старейшин, которые [были] перед домом.
ru.B: Убивайте стариков, юношей и девушек, малых детей и женщин, пока никого не останется; но не подходите ни к кому, на ком есть знак. Начните с {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} святилища.» И они начали со старейшин, стоявших перед храмом.
ru.R: Убейте всех: стариков, юношей и девушек, женщин и маленьких детей. Но не трогайте никого, на ком есть знак. Начните с {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} храма.» И они начали со старейшин, которые были перед храмом.

ja.L: 老人も、若い男もおとめも、幼い子どもも女たちも、殺して滅ぼし尽くしなさい。しかし、しるしがついている者には、だれにも近づいてはならない。わたしの聖所から始めなさい。」そこで彼らは、家の前にいた男たち、長老たちから始めた。
ja.B: 老人も、若い男も若い女も、幼い子どもも女たちも殺し、一人も残してはならない。しかし、しるしのある者には、だれにも近づいてはならない。わたしの聖所から始めなさい。」そこで彼らは、神殿の前にいた長老たちから始めた。
ja.R: 老人も、若い男も若い女も、女たちも小さな子どもたちも、みな殺しなさい。しかし、しるしのある人には、だれにも手を触れてはいけない。わたしの神殿から始めなさい。」そこで彼らは、神殿の前にいた長老たちから始めました。

uk.L: Старого, юнака і дівчину, малих дітей і жінок убивайте до знищення; але не наближайтеся до жодного, на кому [є] знак. І почніть від {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} святилища.» І вони почали з чоловіків, старійшин, що [були] перед домом.
uk.B: Убивайте старих, юнаків і дівчат, малих дітей і жінок, щоб нікого не залишилося; але не підходьте до жодного, хто має знак. Почніть із {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} святилища.» І вони почали зі старійшин, що стояли перед храмом.
uk.R: Убийте всіх: старих, юнаків і дівчат, жінок і малих дітей. Але не чіпайте нікого, хто має знак. Почніть із {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} храму.» Тож вони почали зі старійшин, що були перед храмом.

id.L: Orang tua, pemuda dan gadis, anak-anak kecil dan perempuan-perempuan, bunuhlah sampai binasa; tetapi janganlah mendekati siapa pun yang padanya [ada] tanda itu. Dan mulailah dari tempat kudus-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}." Lalu mereka mulai dengan orang-orang itu, yaitu tua-tua yang [ada] di depan bait itu.
id.B: Bunuhlah sampai habis orang tua, pemuda dan gadis, anak-anak kecil dan perempuan-perempuan, tetapi jangan menyentuh siapa pun yang mempunyai tanda itu. Mulailah dari tempat kudus-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}." Lalu mereka mulai dengan tua-tua yang ada di depan Bait Allah.
id.R: Bunuhlah mereka semua: orang tua, pemuda dan gadis, perempuan dan anak-anak kecil. Tetapi jangan menyentuh siapa pun yang mempunyai tanda itu. Mulailah dari tempat kudus-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}." Jadi mereka mulai dengan para tua-tua yang ada di depan rumah Allah.

tl.L: Ang matandang lalaki, ang binata at ang dalaga, ang maliliit na bata at ang mga babae, patayin ninyo hanggang sa malipol; ngunit huwag ninyong lalapitan ang sinumang may tanda. At magsimula kayo sa aking santuwaryo." Kaya nagsimula sila sa mga lalaki, sa matatanda, na nasa harap ng bahay.
tl.B: Patayin ninyo ang matatandang lalaki, ang mga binata at mga dalaga, ang maliliit na bata at mga babae, hanggang sa walang matira; ngunit huwag ninyong lalapitan ang sinumang may tanda. Magsimula kayo sa aking santuwaryo." Kaya nagsimula sila sa matatandang nakatayo sa harap ng templo.
tl.R: Patayin ninyo silang lahat: ang matatandang lalaki, mga binata at mga dalaga, mga babae at maliliit na bata. Ngunit huwag ninyong gagalawin ang sinumang may tanda. Magsimula kayo sa aking templo." Kaya nagsimula sila sa matatandang nasa harap ng templo.

pa.L: ਬੁੱਢੇ, ਜਵਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਆਰੀ, ਨਿਆਣੇ ਅਤੇ ਤੀਵੀਆਂ, ਨਾਸ ਹੋਣ ਤੱਕ ਵੱਢ ਸੁੱਟੋ; ਪਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ [ਹੈ]। ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਸਥਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੋ।" ਸੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਤੋਂ, ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ, ਜੋ ਭਵਨ ਦੇ ਅੱਗੇ [ਸਨ], ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕੀਤਾ।
pa.B: ਬੁੱਢਿਆਂ, ਜਵਾਨ ਮੁੰਡਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ, ਨਿਆਣਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੀਵੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰ ਸੁੱਟੋ, ਜਦ ਤੱਕ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਬਚੇ; ਪਰ ਜਿਸ ਕਿਸੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਹੋਵੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ। ਮੇਰੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਸਥਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੋ।" ਸੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਹੈਕਲ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕੀਤਾ।
pa.R: ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰ ਸੁੱਟੋ: ਬੁੱਢਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ, ਜਵਾਨ ਮੁੰਡਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ, ਤੀਵੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਛੋਟੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ। ਪਰ ਜਿਸ ਕਿਸੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਹੋਵੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਥ ਨਾ ਲਾਉਣਾ। ਮੇਰੀ ਹੈਕਲ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੋ।" ਸੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਹੈਕਲ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਸਨ।

zh.L: 要把老年人、少年人、少女、孩童和妇女都杀尽灭绝；但身上有记号的人，你们都不要挨近。要从我的圣所开始。”他们就从殿前的那些人，就是那些长老开始。
zh.B: 要把老人、青年男女、孩童和妇女都杀掉，一个不留；但不要挨近任何有记号的人。要从我的圣所开始。”他们就从站在殿前的长老开始。
zh.R: 要把他们全都杀掉：老人、年轻男女、妇女和孩童。但不要碰任何有记号的人。要从我的圣殿开始。”他们就从圣殿前面的长老开始杀起。

decisions.choice: begin from my sanctuary: judgment starts where the sin was worst, in God's own house
decisions.reason: The abominations of chapter 8 were done in the temple, so the judgment starts there. 1 Peter 4:17 says, in another setting, that judgment begins with the household of God.

decisions.choice: the elders in front of the house: the leaders seen in chapter 8
decisions.reason: The text does not say which group is meant. The twenty-five men of 8:16 stood in front of the temple, and the seventy elders of 8:11 were the city's leaders; either way, the judgment starts with those who led the worship of other gods.

decisions.choice: kill to destruction: kill completely
decisions.reason: The phrase means killing that leaves no one, except those who bear the mark.

decisions.choice: until none are left (B); Kill them all (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "to destruction" means (m3). Readable puts the command first and lists those it includes after it.

decisions.choice: old man "ሽማግሌ", young man "ጎበዝ", young woman "ቆንጆ" (Literal, Balanced); Readable "ወጣት ወንዶችንና ወጣት ሴቶችን"
decisions.reason: The list is kept in the Hebrew order at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses plain words, as its English does.

decisions.choice: मेरा पवित्रस्थान (L, B); मेरा मन्दिर (R)
decisions.reason: Judgment begins in God's own house (m1). The sanctuary (miqdash) is पवित्रस्थान, as the Pentateuch note settles; Readable says मन्दिर, as the English Readable says "temple".

decisions.choice: कुँवारी (L); युवतियाँ (B, R)
decisions.reason: Betulah here means a young woman of marriageable age; Literal keeps कुँवारी, Balanced and Readable say युवती.

decisions.choice: tahargu lemashchit "殺して滅ぼし尽くしなさい" (L), "殺し、一人も残してはならない" (B), "みな殺しなさい" (R), as the English kill to destruction / until none are left / Kill them all; miqdashi "わたしの聖所" (L, B), "わたしの神殿" (R).
decisions.reason: The phrase means to kill completely (m3); Japanese does not soften the command. The order of the list follows each English level.

decisions.choice: "tempat kudus-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}"; "tua-tua yang [ada] di depan bait itu"
decisions.reason: Judgment starts in God's own house (m1); the elders are probably those of chapter 8 (m2, uncertain).

decisions.choice: "magsimula kayo sa aking santuwaryo"
decisions.reason: Judgment starts where the sin was worst, in God's own house (m1).

decisions.choice: "matatanda, na nasa harap ng bahay"
decisions.reason: The leaders seen in chapter 8 (m2).

decisions.choice: "patayin ninyo hanggang sa malipol"
decisions.reason: Kill completely (m3).

decisions.choice: "ਮੇਰਾ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਸਥਾਨ" (L, B); "ਮੇਰੀ ਹੈਕਲ" (R)
decisions.reason: Judgment begins at the sanctuary.
Betulah, a young woman of marriageable age.
